q: my class 8B has fallen behind on fractions, what do I do
reply:
Start by assessing where the misunderstanding is. It might not be the concept of fractions themselves, but earlier skills like equivalent fractions or common denominators. Give them a few exercises focusing on equivalence and adding fractions with like denominators, and track which areas they're struggling with. You can then reteach the specific skill they need help with.

Reset the pace to one concept per lesson and incorporate quick reviews to reinforce prior material. That was one question in a chat box; Paperhint does this at your desk all day — on your syllabus, with your rubric, across every class.

q: தமிழில் சொல்ல முடியுமா, இது எப்படி வேலை செய்கிறது?
